about_the_game:
Get ready to jump into a challenge. This is a tough jumping puzzle game where you control both your running speed and jump height. Your goal is to figure out how high your character needs to jump and how fast it needs to move to get past each obstacle. The levels become more difficult as you progress, and every mistake could send you a long way back. No enemies. No shortcuts. Just gravity, your skill, and plenty of patience. If you find it too hard, there is an easy mode available.

  • Jump. Fall. Repeat. Inner peace optional

  • Real-time control of movement adjust your speed and jump height with precision

  • Carefully crafted stages every obstacle tests your timing and coordination

  • One wrong jump means going back, maybe a little, maybe a lot

  • Peaceful visuals, quiet tension a calm world hiding a harsh challenge

  • This is where gravity stops being theoretical and starts feeling emotional
